cards.answer: Ryze is a magic-damage mage whose spells benefit from bonus mana and whose ability power increases his maximum mana. He applies Flux to empower follow-up spells and resets Q with his other basic abilities.
cards.counterplay: Keep space from Flux-marked enemies and back away when marked.

cards.answer: Overload fires a line projectile that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit; against a Flux-marked target, it deals increased damage and spreads to nearby Flux-marked enemies. His other basic ability casts reset Overload and charge runes; casting Overload with fully charged runes consumes them and briefly grants movement speed.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the projectile, spread away from marked allies, and expect follow-up casts after his other basic spells.

cards.answer: Realm Warp passively increases Overload's damage against Flux-marked targets. Its active channels a portal that teleports Ryze and allied units inside to a chosen destination after a delay. Ryze can act during the channel, but interruption cancels the portal.
cards.counterplay: Use crowd control to interrupt the channel and prepare for allies arriving at the destination.
